verdict.rationale: Elicit documents agent-driven work that runs without the user present. Routines "hand you a finished analysis", and the API generates automated research reports from scripts. However, Routines are recurring monitors rather than a one-off long job. The only documented email notification is Alerts for newly found papers, not job completion. missing for 10: explicit background/unattended execution of a one-off long research job, a documented notification (email/in-app) when that job's result is ready, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an analyst, I can start a long research job that keeps working unattended and notifies me when the result is ready

citations.quote: A Routine can act on what it finds and hand you a finished analysis: it can filter on criteria an Alert couldn't, update an artifact, or write the summary
generate automated research reports from your own code, scripts, and workflows
Enter any research question in Elicit to generate a research-backed report!
